presentation_revision_history.prompt: One beautiful painterly realistic mythology illustration, vertical 2:3, NO text. Nekhbet in documented Egyptian goddess VULTURE form, not human hybrid. One natural vulture hovers with BOTH full wings spread, head turned slightly toward viewer, ordinary bird legs and claws. Beneath its feet it holds one simple small shen symbol: circular protective loop of plain gold-coloured material resting above a short horizontal baseline. Do not put lettering on it. Vast pale limestone desert landscape far below in natural warm morning sunlight. Bird correctly proportioned, no giant invented scale. Protective majestic presence through expansive wings and clear composition. No magical aura, halo, glowing outlines, energy smoke, or extra heads. Do not add goddess human body, crown or borrowed attributes. Editorial background.
